verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's marketplace clearly spans a wide range of GPU types (search examples show RTX_4090, and docs reference 20,000+ GPUs with searchable filters like gpu_name), plus datacenter-tier verification (Secure Cloud/TIER 2-3) for production use, supporting the general premise of tiered GPU choice at varying price points. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms availability of current-generation H100/H200/B200-class GPUs or explicitly contrasts them with older-generation options in the search/pricing docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation or listing confirming H100/H200/B200 availability, explicit mention of generation-based filtering/pricing tiers, independent confirmation of current-gen GPU stock levels.
